root_cause: Missing Level 2/3 transaction data caused Visa credit sales to be downgraded to a higher‑cost interchange tier.
diagnosis: Because the merchant did not supply L2/L3 data, the transactions were processed at a non‑qualified rate, resulting in fees above the modeled benchmark expected_fee.
action_rationale: Providing Level 2/3 data will qualify the sales for lower interchange rates and eliminate the overcharge.
